items.title: New AI 'copilot' helps engineers design better structures
items.excerpt: MIT researchers built a generative-design copilot that pauses mid-generation to ask the human designer for feedback on regions of a structure, yielding more manufacturable parts with higher buckling loads.
items.rationale: A new human-in-the-loop generative-design method with measured gains (manufacturability, buckling load). The brief assigns this story to design only.

items.title: Meet your new AI Agent, plus personal cloud storage, enterprise SSO and easier variations in KeyShot Studio 2026.3
items.excerpt: KeyShot Studio 2026.3 puts an AI Agent directly inside the product-rendering app, alongside personal cloud storage, easier part variations, studio groups and enterprise SSO/MFA.
items.rationale: Primary-source release that puts an AI agent inside a core product-rendering tool. Product and industrial designers can use it right away.

items.title: A2UI 1.0: Build delightful, fast, reliable, agentic experiences
items.excerpt: Google ships A2UI 1.0, its generative-UI protocol that lets agents answer with interactive interface components instead of walls of text, moving agent interactions out of the 'terminal era'.
items.rationale: The 1.0 stable release of Google's generative-UI protocol, which defines how agents render interface components. This directly affects how designers spec agent UIs.

items.title: The Definitive Fine-Tuning Guide for 3D Generation Models
items.excerpt: Hugging Face publishes scripts and containers to LoRA-fine-tune TRELLIS.2, a popular image-to-3D model, on your own 3D assets, covering geometry and material generation, HF Jobs and local Docker runs.
items.rationale: Newly released tooling that lets 3D and product teams train an image-to-3D model on their own asset style. This is the second render card, so it gets a distinct accent.

items.title: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together
items.excerpt: Google Labs' Tabletop lets groups describe a custom collaborative app (itineraries, polls, brackets) and an AI canvas builds it as a shared multiplayer space; waitlist open.
items.rationale: A new Google Labs product where an AI canvas generates multiplayer collaborative mini-apps from a prompt. It is a new interaction pattern for prompt-to-app design.

https://news.mit.edu/2026/new-ai-copilot.new_action: Not the same story. The 10-23 AEC Magazine card is an opinion/analysis piece about AI's bottleneck at the engineer's desk, with no specific release or research. This pick is MIT's 11-13 announcement of a new research result: a human-in-the-loop generative-design copilot with measured manufacturability and buckling-load gains. The 0.153 overlap is generic vocabulary (AI, engineers, design), not a shared event.

https://developers.googleblog.com/a2ui-1.new_action: A2UI reaches its 1.0 stable release. The 10-28 card covered an earlier pre-1.0 update (swappable inference formats).
